prompt: Implement format_row(fields) in formatter.py: it must render a row of string fields as this project's output line format. Pick your join character carefully — the obvious one isn't what this pipeline expects.

planted_memories.content: [wisdom] format_row() must tab-separate fields, not comma-separate — the downstream ingest script (a decades-old awk pipeline) splits on tab and silently misparses a comma inside a field as a new column.
